reviews.text: Really fun Duck Hunt type of game. Upgrade your weapons, and purchase new weapons. One thing wasn't clear and that is your inventory which is the neon green backpack on the upper right of the main screen. Full controller support. https://steamcommunity.com/groups/towerdefensegamesrated
It's a fun and easy game to play for a couple of hours! Some UI improvements and items to spice up the gameplay would be nice to have.
A very fun experience with a playful visual style and consistently light, engaging gameplay that stays enjoyable throughout.
Chicken Coop Invaders is an intense hybrid of FPS action and tower defense where Lucas must defend his grandfather's ranch from Supremetoid’s army of bizarre alien invaders.
An FPS-tower defense hybrid where Lucas defends his grandpa’s ranch from aliens. Stop waves of invaders to rescue 410 chickens across 40+ intense levels with controller support.
A frantic FPS with Tower Defense mechanics.You play as Lucas and must protect the chickens from bizarre alien hordes across 40 levels. A wild, chaotic blend of trap-setting and fast-paced shooting.
FPS with tower defense elements. Defend chickens from alien hordes across 40+ levels. 410 chickens to save. Very fun.
